_meta.label: Custom-prepared from manual research
_meta.preparedBy: coding agent (Claude), from the Constitution of Kenya 2010, the County Governments Act 2012, the Elections Act 2011 and the NG-CDF Act 2015
_meta.caveat: Cardinalities cited to the Constitution are as the articles read; statutory ceilings and committee sizes marked "to be confirmed" must be checked against the Acts. A pattern generates posts and expectations only: never coordinates, addresses, buildings or rooms.

codeNote: County codes use the First Schedule number (ke/county/047/governor is Nairobi). Constituency and ward codes use the geography unit path.

constituency.basis: Constitution of Kenya 2010, art. 89 and IEBC 2012 review (290 constituencies)

ward.basis: IEBC delimitation of 2012 (1,450 wards); the geography data holds 1,452

patterns.description: Executive of each county government: governor, deputy governor, county executive committee members, county secretary and chief officers.

offices.title: Governor of {name} County
offices.appointingAuthority: Direct election by registered voters of the county

offices.title: Deputy Governor of {name} County
offices.appointingAuthority: Elected jointly with the governor as running mate

offices.title: County Executive Committee Member, {name} County
offices.appointingAuthority: Governor, with the approval of the county assembly, from persons who are not members of the assembly
offices.legalBasis: Constitution of Kenya 2010, art. 179(2)(b); County Governments Act, 2012, s. 35 (not more than ten members)
offices.note: The Constitution fixes the composition and the County Governments Act the ceiling of ten; the actual number in a county is not derived from a rule and stays unknown until researched.

offices.title: County Secretary, {name} County
offices.appointingAuthority: Governor, with the approval of the county assembly

offices.title: County Chief Officer, {name} County
offices.appointingAuthority: Governor, with the approval of the county assembly
offices.note: The number of chief officers equals the number of county departments and varies by county.

expectations.subject: institution
expectations.legalBasis: County government headquarters (a county is expected to have a seat of its executive); location is research output.

expectations.subject: office:governor
expectations.legalBasis: The governor is expected to have an official workplace; no address is implied.

patterns.description: Each county assembly: speaker, clerk and the nominated members who are not tied to a ward.

offices.title: Speaker of the {name} County Assembly
offices.appointingAuthority: Elected by the county assembly members from outside their number

offices.title: Clerk of the {name} County Assembly
offices.appointingAuthority: County Assembly Service Board
offices.legalBasis: County Governments Act, 2012; County Assembly Services Act, 2017

offices.title: Member of the {name} County Assembly, marginalised-group seat
offices.appointingAuthority: Nominated by political parties according to their party lists
offices.legalBasis: Constitution of Kenya 2010, art. 177(1)(c) (six members representing marginalised groups including persons with disabilities and the youth)

offices.title: Member of the {name} County Assembly, gender top-up seat
offices.appointingAuthority: Nominated by political parties according to their party lists, as many as needed so that no more than two thirds are of one gender
offices.note: The number depends on the result of each election and is not fixed by rule.

expectations.subject: institution
expectations.legalBasis: County assembly buildings; location is research output.

patterns.description: One elected member of the county assembly per ward.

offices.title: Member of the County Assembly, {name} ward
offices.appointingAuthority: Direct election by registered voters of the ward

patterns.description: One elected Member of the National Assembly per constituency. Existing seat offices scoped to the constituency are adopted, never duplicated.

offices.title: Member of the National Assembly, {name} constituency
offices.appointingAuthority: Direct election by registered voters of the constituency

expectations.subject: office:constituency-mp
expectations.legalBasis: A Member of the National Assembly is expected to run a constituency office (see the physical locations of constituency offices published by the IEBC/NG-CDF); no address is implied.

patterns.description: One Woman Representative in the National Assembly and one Senator per county.

offices.title: Woman Representative, {name} County
offices.appointingAuthority: Direct election by registered voters of the county

offices.title: Senator, {name} County
offices.appointingAuthority: Direct election by registered voters of the county

patterns.description: Nominated members of Parliament, which belong to no constituency or county.

offices.title: Nominated Member of the National Assembly
offices.appointingAuthority: Political parties, according to their party lists, to represent special interests including the youth, persons with disabilities and workers

offices.title: Nominated Senator (woman)
offices.appointingAuthority: Political parties, according to their party lists

offices.title: Nominated Senator (youth)
offices.appointingAuthority: Political parties, according to their party lists (one man and one woman)

offices.title: Nominated Senator (person with a disability)
offices.appointingAuthority: Political parties, according to their party lists (one man and one woman)

patterns.description: NG-CDF committee posts for each constituency. The committee size and nomination rules are in the NG-CDF Act, 2015 and must be confirmed; cardinality is recorded as unknown beyond the single posts.

offices.title: NG-CDF Fund Account Manager, {name} constituency
offices.appointingAuthority: NG-CDF Board
offices.legalBasis: National Government Constituencies Development Fund Act, 2015

offices.title: NG-CDF Committee Chairperson, {name} constituency
offices.appointingAuthority: Committee members
offices.legalBasis: National Government Constituencies Development Fund Act, 2015, s. 43 (to be confirmed)

offices.title: NG-CDF Committee Member, {name} constituency
offices.appointingAuthority: Nominated as the Act provides
offices.legalBasis: National Government Constituencies Development Fund Act, 2015, s. 43 (to be confirmed)
offices.note: Committee size and nominating bodies are not recorded in this seed; the number is a known unknown.

expectations.subject: unit
expectations.legalBasis: Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission Act, 2011; Elections Act, 2011 (county returning officers)

patterns.description: IEBC county election office, {name} for every county.
IEBC constituency election office, {name} for every constituency.

expectations.subject: unit
expectations.legalBasis: National Government Constituencies Development Fund Act, 2015

patterns.description: NG-CDF constituency office, {name} for every constituency.
TSC county office, {name} for every county.
County Land Management Board, {name} for every county.

expectations.subject: unit
expectations.legalBasis: Office of the Director of Public Prosecutions Act, 2013

patterns.description: ODPP county office, {name} for every county.
DCI county criminal investigation office, {name} for every county.

expectations.subject: unit
expectations.legalBasis: Constitution of Kenya 2010, art. 165; Judiciary access-to-justice plan (a High Court station in each county)

patterns.description: High Court station, {name} for every county.
